steps-axial-v2.json.title: Fit optional Ruthex inserts into lower corners
steps-axial-v2.json.text: If M3 locking is wanted, heat-set three M3S inserts into the outside pilot holes of each lower corner before building the frame. Insert dimensions are symbolic here.

steps-axial-v2.json.title: Build upper and lower horizontal beam assemblies
steps-axial-v2.json.text: Fit two corner connectors onto each horizontal SQ15 tube, one from each end. The four connectors move only along the horizontal tube axes. Keep the upper and lower beam assemblies separate; vertical tubes are added in the next step. Tube length 600 mm is illustrative.

steps-axial-v2.json.title: Insert vertical tubes, then close the frame
steps-axial-v2.json.text: First lower both vertical tubes axially into the lower beam assembly. Then lower the complete upper beam assembly onto their free ends. The upper horizontal tube and both upper connectors move together; there is no diagonal connector movement.

phases.label: 1 / 2 · Insert both vertical tubes into the lower connectors
2 / 2 · Lower the upper beam assembly onto both vertical tubes

steps-axial-v2.json.title: LED strips on tube front faces (illustration)
steps-axial-v2.json.text: Orientation only: the strip is on the +Z/front face. Strip type, pads, wiring and corner routing are not decided. This is not an electrical installation instruction.

steps-axial-v2.json.title: Clip SQ8W diffusers on from the front
steps-axial-v2.json.text: Per tube: end - middle - end, each 199.8 mm with two 0.3 mm joints. Press from the front until the legs engage behind the tube edges. Orient the end segments with their 35 mm dome-only zones over the corner arms. Undeformed CAD shows intended pinch preload; full-set fit remains untested.

steps-axial-v2.json.title: Build feet: tubes into foot brackets, then end caps
steps-axial-v2.json.text: Insert front and rear foot tubes 30 mm to the 4 mm stop in each selected foot brackets. Push each v2 end cap 20 mm onto the free tube end. No glue. Foot overhang 250 mm is only an assumption; no approved foot length is implied.

steps-axial-v2.json.title: Lower the gate vertically into the feet
steps-axial-v2.json.text: Lower the frame vertically so both lower-corner dovetails enter the open-top selected foot brackets grooves and reach the closed 45-degree floor. Screwless stand-in is an experiment: this updated selected foot brackets fit has not been physically tested. This is not a positive anti-lift latch; the frame can be lifted out.

steps-axial-v2.json.title: Optional M3 locking screws
steps-axial-v2.json.text: If additional locking is required, fit three M3 screws from the outside of each selected foot brackets into the corner inserts. Screws are symbolic; final length and Ruthex installation remain untested. Without these, retention is only by the dovetail/friction; no snap detent is integrated.

steps.json.title: Fit optional Ruthex inserts into lower corners
steps.json.text: If M3 locking is wanted, heat-set three M3S inserts into the outside pilot holes of each lower corner before building the frame. Insert dimensions are symbolic here.

steps.json.title: Assemble frame: tubes into corners
steps.json.text: Insert each tube 30 mm to the corner stop. Crush ribs provide friction retention; no glue. The front face contacts the 45-degree seats. Use the corner detail to understand each axial insertion: the full-frame animation spreads corners diagonally for visibility, NOT as a literal simultaneous assembly path. Close the frame progressively while all required axial directions remain accessible. Tube length 600 mm is assumed.

motions.json.label: Remove optional M3 screws
motions.json.note: Symbolic hardware. Left screws move outward to -X; right screws to +X.

motions.json.label: Release both latch hooks
motions.json.note: FB4.1 only: acknowledge pressing both hooks outward before lifting. Spring deformation and forces are not simulated.

motions.json.label: Lift gate out of feet
motions.json.note: The frame and attached parts move together. Screwless FB3.1 has no positive anti-lift latch.

motions.json.label: Remove diffuser segments
motions.json.note: Rigid illustrative clip motion; designed preload is not elastic simulation.

motions.json.label: Lift upper rail with both corners
motions.json.note: Both upper corner sockets disengage axially from the upright tubes. A schematic path, without a collision sweep.

motions.json.label: Remove right upper corner
motions.json.note: Slide axially off the horizontal tube, then move clear. Two-stage explanatory path.

motions.json.label: Pull upper tube from left corner
motions.json.note: Pull to +X after the right corner has cleared. Attached LED illustration follows the tube.
